gazetteer_names_needed.name: Qasr Ibrim
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Primis, fortress on the east bank of the Nile in Lower Nubia, 22.65 N 31.99 E; given as a coordinate in makuria and nobatia

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Gebel Adda
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Makurian capital after 1365, east bank opposite Abu Simbel, c. 22.31 N 31.62 E, under Lake Nasser

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Faras
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Pachoras, Nobatia's capital, west bank just north of Wadi Halfa, c. 22.2 N 31.48 E

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Kalabsha
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Talmis, Blemmyan capital in the Dodekaschoinos, c. 23.55 N 32.87 E

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Abu Hamad
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Nile town at the great bend, c. 19.5 N 33.3 E; northern limit of Alodia's al-Abwab

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Dodekaschoinos
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Lower Nubia from Philae to Hiera Sykaminos (Maharraqa); given as Lower Nubia within 115 km of Aswan

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Triakontaschoinos
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Lower Nubia from the first to the second cataract; given as the gazetteer's Lower Nubia

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Batn el-Hajar
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: the second-cataract reach south of Wadi Halfa, the Nobatia-Makuria frontier

gazetteer_names_needed.name: al-Maris
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Arabic name of Lower Nubia (Nobatia) under Makuria

gazetteer_names_needed.name: al-Abwab
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Alodia's northern province, the Nile from the Atbara confluence to Abu Hamad; given as River Nile state minus 120 km around Shendi

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Butana
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: the grassland between the Nile and the Atbara, east of Meroe

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Nuba Mountains
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Al-Ahdin, South Kordofan hills held by Alodia in the 10th century

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Fazughli
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Blue Nile borderland mountains, c. 11.3 N 34.9 E, the Alodian remnant's refuge

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Lasta
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: highland district around Lalibela, the Zagwe power base (Cliopatria's Zagwe shape)

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Dongola reach
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: the Nile between the third cataract and Abu Hamad, Makuria's core

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Aksumite heartland
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Tigray with the Eritrean highlands (Maekel, Debub) only; 'Tigray (region)' covers all Eritrea
